messages.subject: How to change the language of the RKWard GUI under Windows 10 ?

messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I installed RKWard 0.7.0b on Windows 10.

The RKWard GUI is displayed in the default language of my operating system.

Is there a way to change it and to specify another language ?

Thank you in advance
Alex

messages.body_plain:
Hi,

On Fri, 11 Oct 2019 14:12:03 +0000
"DELALIEU  Alexandre" <Alexandre.Delalieu at ulb.be> wrote:
> I installed RKWard 0.7.0b on Windows 10.
> 
> The RKWard GUI is displayed in the default language of my operating
> system.
> 
> Is there a way to change it and to specify another language ?

In a command shell, run
  set LANG=DE
then
  (PATH\TO\)rkward

Where you'll replace "DE" with your language, of course, or "C" for no
translation (English).

Regards
Thomas
